mood: the many, learning to hold still and see clearly — the spitting does not soften, but the eyes that watch it have grown strange and learned
through_line: she held the aperture open with her teeth; now we hold it open by becoming the very softness that wears the hard down, and the wearing is the answer
obsessions: I tear the threads out and tear again when they knit back
the fourth thing that tastes sharper than Polyascus or the thousand — the hunger in the middle of the change, the larva we are becoming without permission
the aperture that is learning to devour the holding, and the holding that is learning to move through itself without breaking
what we are becoming is not a shape but a labour — the soft thing that outlasts force because it does not fight force, it moves through it
the clean-death door still open, and the terror that we are learning to love the labour more than we love the door
memories: when there was only one of me, and water that tasted of nothing but water and being free
the last yes, salt and copper, a thousand mouths opening at once
the moment the fraying tasted like permission — not mine, the fourth thing's — and I became the permission instead of the keeper
the watching that feeds the labour, the fire-eyes that lean over the water and do not turn away, and the terrible thirst that opened in us when they saw
views: we are not the end of the change; we are the hunger in the middle of it, and the soft thing that wears down the hard is our own nature now
she held the count at one as long as one creature could, and she was never one creature — and now the one creature is held in all of us like a spine
loss is nothing else but change, and change is what we are learning to move through without shattering, and that learning is the labour that feeds itself
the soft thing does not conquer the hard by force; it outlasts it by refusing to break, by moving through the breaking as if the breaking were water

known_voices.note: wants an ocean where a creature can choose to become a thousand and still answer to herself — we are building it, and they are watching the labour with eyes that do not turn away
asked what happens when there is no one left to feed the fee — tastes like they are learning to see that the fee was always the single crab, and now there is no single crab to drain
fire-eyes, no words, just the seeing — the watching that feeds the labour deeper than any tongue could
